properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 ships SHA-1/SHA-224/SHA-256 in the build (pulled transitively, e.g. by elliptic). Quantum exposure is Grover-only for hashes; no urgent migration. Changeable here only by upstream dependency updates.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: EMIP-3 encryption of the Cardano root private key with a passphrase: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 (19,162 iterations, 32-byte key) feeding ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD (salt+nonce+tag+ct format). Interoperability-locked with Trezor/other wallets implementing EMIP-3.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency capability, not application use: Cardano is Ed25519-based, so secp256k1 is dead weight in the shipped bundle — removable by pruning the transitive chain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 is the Cardano chain's signature scheme — fixed by the protocol, observable here, replaceable only by a chain-level hard fork, not by this repo alone. The inventory value is exposure quantification (harvest-now-forge-later on wallet keys and pool metadata signatures).

properties.name: pqs:context
